messages:
Maria (sec-eng): Heads-up — starting AWS KMS integration work for Redwood Private (VPC) control plane + data-plane. question: should control plane and dataplane use the same CMK or separate keys?
Josh (infra): separate CMKs. keep KEK for control plane, DEKs for dataplane. separation reduces blast radius. :+1:
Devon (platform): Agree. control plane CMK needs tighter RBAC (only control-plane service account + security-admins). dataplane keys used by inference nodes should have narrow grants.
Samir (sre): +1. Also want explicit encryption-context on all calls so we can audit by context. e.g., `EncryptionContext={'env':'prod','component':'dataplane','tenant_id':...}`
Maria (sec-eng): Good call. How do we want cross-account access for customer-owned BYOK? customers might provide CMKs in their acct for private deployments.
Josh (infra): For BYOKs we will use cross-account grants + key policy that allows our service principal. prefer use of `GrantToken` flow + temporary grants rather than widening the key policy. document: minimal IAM + grant.
Devon (platform): Operationally we should support two modes: 1) Redwood-managed KEK (default) and 2) Customer-managed CMK (BYOK). For BYOK: require a preflight verification step (policy check, valid alias, encryption context whitelisted).
Maria (sec-eng): Audit logging question: CloudTrail logs KMS API calls, but we also need token-level mapping in our control plane. plan: send KMS call meta to our observability pipeline and retain CloudTrail for legal. retention 1 year by default, extend per enterprise contract.
Samir (sre): Also capture `ReEncrypt` events; key rotation will trigger rewrap ops. we should monitor `ReEncrypt` spikes. alert if unexpected high re-encrypts.
oncall-ops: deploy-bot: "Control plane deploy started"
Josh (infra): Rotation/process Q: automatic KMS rotation vs manual. Recommendation: enable automatic rotation on CMKs we control (annually), but for BYOK require customer-managed rotation and a rewrap handshake window.
Maria (sec-eng): For key rotation mechanics: we will not decrypt stored ciphertext at rest; we store DEKs encrypted under KEK. rotation => re-encrypt DEKs with new KEK via `ReEncrypt` (no plaintext KEKs leave KMS). Provide a one-click rewrap job and a dry-run mode using `reEncrypt` with `DestinationEncryptionContext`.
Devon (platform): sample rewrap snippet: ```bash
# rewrap all DEKs in S3 prefix (pseudo)
aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://dek.bin --destination-key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/NEW_KEY_ID --destination-encryption-context '{"component":"dataplane"}'
```
Maria (sec-eng): RBAC changes: control plane role needs `kms:Decrypt`, `kms:ReEncrypt*`, `kms:DescribeKey` on control-plane CMK only. dataplane node role gets `kms:Encrypt`/`kms:Decrypt` on its DEK-wrapping CMK with condition on encryption context.
Samir (sre): Add tight conditions: `kms:EncryptionContext:contains` or `kms:CallerAccount` checks. also `aws:sourceVpce` for VPC endpoint enforcement.
Josh (infra): Grants vs key policy: prefer granting `CreateGrant` at deploy time and then using grants for short-term operations to limit blast radius. store grant tokens in KMS audit metadata.
Maria (sec-eng): Vulnerability triage / incident path: if a CMK is suspected compromised (priv keys leaked via IAM creds misuse), immediate steps: 1) disable key (set `KeyState` to PendingDeletion? maybe schedule), 2) revoke all grants, 3) rotate to new CMK and rewrap DEKs, 4) revoke service principals and rotate service account creds, 5) run integrity checks on stored ciphertexts. document oncall steps.
Devon (platform): Note: `ScheduleKeyDeletion` is irreversible after 7 days; prefer `DisableKey` while triaging. keep deletion as last resort.
Maria (sec-eng): Incident automation idea: a playbook that runs a preflight rewrap to a staging KEK, runs smoke tests (generate, decrypt), then promotes KEK. minimizes app downtime.
oncall-ops: oncall-ops: ack — will add runbook steps to oncall rotation.
Samir (sre): Audit notes: ensure CloudTrail is configured to log `kms.amazonaws.com` events to a separate secure S3 with MFA-delete for high-tier customers. sync CloudTrail to SIEM and tag events with `encryption_context` extracted from request parameters.
Josh (infra): Testing: need e2e test in staging that exercises BYOK onboarding, rewrap, rotation, and failure scenarios (KMS unavailable -> fallback?). We should define graceful degradation: if KMS unavailable, fail fast for control plane operations; for dataplane tokenized inference prefer cached DEK in memory with TTL to serve a short window.
Maria (sec-eng): HSM fallback and BYOK HSM: support for CloudHSM/BYOK HSM is a separate track; if customer's CMK is backed by HSM we must ensure our grant flow works. fallback to customer-managed fallback key is documented.
Devon (platform): Edge-case: key compromise + customer BYOK — customer is responsible for rotation, but we must provide tooling to rewrap with a new CMK. include a signed onboarding manifest for BYOK updates.
Maria (sec-eng): Action items: Josh -> write minimal IAM + grant templates. Devon -> implement rewrap dry-run & promotion pipeline. Samir -> add CloudTrail->SIEM mapping & alerts. I'll draft incident playbook and RBAC diffs.
Josh (infra): I'll put a PR with IAM snippets + example grant lifecycle.
Devon (platform): I'll add a `rewrap` job to infra pipeline and a `--dry-run` flag.
Samir (sre): I'll wire alerts for `ReEncrypt` spikes and KMS API error rates.
Maria (sec-eng): Thanks all. will post the draft playbook later. cc @sec-bot for checklist. :eyes:
sec-bot: checklist created: [preflight_policy_check, encryption_context_required, grant_lifecycle, rewrap_dry_run, cloudtrail_to_siem].
Maria (sec-eng): one last note — include clear telemetry for per-tenant rewrap progress, so support can call out impacted tenants during incidents.
Josh (infra): noted. quick IAM example for reference: ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:ReEncrypt*","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/CONTROLPLANE-KEY-ID","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:EncryptionContext:component":"controlplane"}}}
  ]
}
```
Maria (sec-eng): perfect. end of thread — will follow up with PR links and playbook draft.
